story.en: ...Where have you been all this time. You weren't answering.
You went all the way to Nambu 'Market' alone? That's dangerous.

story.text: '밤'늦게 낯선 사람이랑 다니지 마요. 이 동네 어두운 골목 많아요.
story.reading: 'bam'neuj-ge nach-seon sa-ram-i-rang da-ni-ji ma-yo. i dong-ne eo-du-un gol-mok man-a-yo.
story.en: Don't wander around late at 'night' with strangers. This neighborhood has a lot of dark alleys.

story.text: …아까 그 '사람'이랑 뭐 했어요. 그냥 궁금해서 그래요.
story.reading: …a-kka geu 'sa-ram'i-rang mwo haess-eo-yo. geu-nyang gung-geum-hae-seo geu-rae-yo.
story.en: ...What were you doing with that 'person' earlier. I'm just curious, that's all.

story.text: 됐어요. 왜 그런 '표정'으로 봐요. 신경 안 써요, 진짜.
story.reading: dwaess-eo-yo. wae geu-reon 'pyo-jeong'eu-ro bwa-yo. sin-gyeong an sseo-yo, jin-jja.
story.en: Never mind. Why are you looking at me with that 'expression'. I really don't care.

story.text: …아니다, 신경 쓰여요. 자, 오늘은 여기까지만 해요.
story.reading: …a-ni-da, sin-gyeong sseu-yeo-yo. ja, o-neul-eun yeo-gi-kka-ji-man hae-yo.
story.en: ...No, actually, I do care. Alright, let's stop here for today.

words.example_en: They sell delicious food at the market.
The market is livelier at night.
Why do you have that expression?

sentences.en: There are so many people at the market.
I went to the night market with a friend.
Now that it's night, the lights are pretty.
That person's expression looks a bit strange.
Try to manage your expression a little.
